profile.headline: Cloud and AI Architect at OpenTable
profile.summary: Hard working, self-motivated, outside the box thinker, problem solver, and a leader.  AWS Solutions Architect - Professional Sept '17.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description: Working on teams for consulting projects in AWS for various clients. Building proposals for clients, giving tech talks, mentoring, as well as implementing AWS best practices across different types of projects. One project included implementing an open source BI solution with Amazon Athena, Glue, S3, EC2 and various other services. Another project included deep planning of lifting and shifting a platform, while removing large numbers of dependencies, and redesigning for scalability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer -
Work in team environment developing using Java, Node.js and Python. Develop microservices, and design for cloud implementation with AWS. Engage in sprint planning and work with DevOps teams to deploy via CI/CD.

DevOps -
Partner with development teams and the operations group to enable the teams with CI/CD as well as maintaining standardization and documentation. Guide teams towards technologies that can solve problems as well as provide technical knowledge on techniques to promote scalable and reliable implementations and monitoring. Continuous work on AWS cloudification of services as well as deploying dockerized microservices. Creator and promoter of a Slack ChatOps Authentication Framework enabling enhanced productivity to several teams within Operations as well as Development.

positions.title: Computer Systems Analyst/Systems Integration/Test Engineer Sr.
Network Administrator
positions.description:
Designing, monitoring, and maintaining network infrastructure at local site in Guadalupe, and remote sites across the US. Using the ManageEngine OpManager for SNMP and WMI monitoring of Cisco Routers (1921's), Switches (Various 3750X, 2960X, 2960S), Adaptive Security Appliances (Various ASA 5515, ASA 5510, ASA 5505), as well as our Virtual and Physical server infrastructure. Maintain the IPSec tunnels between all sites as well as having failover networks in place with OSPF routing utilizing IP SLA rules for failover.

Help Desk support is also a function of my role as we do not have a dedicated help desk. I support the users with a wide range of requests from Active Directory unlocking of passwords to setting up Distribution Lists, to moving the office computers as well as running CAT6 and terminating new wiring into patch panels. 

 I am involved with planning and purchasing of new equipment and software to solve any business requirement from Business Intelligence to an Electronic Document System.

Also, performing security updates and documentation to comply with Sarbanes–Oxley for JD Edwards EnterpriseOne. I worked on the upgrade team for JD Edwards XE to JD Edwards EnterpriseOne which was successfully migrated to in September of 2014.

Technologies used and proficient with:
VMware ESX 5.5
NetApp FAS 2240's
HP Proliant Servers Gen6-Gen8
Symantec Backup Exec 2012
Veeam
Microsoft Server 2003 - 2012
Microsoft Windows 7 and 8 (Also proficient with older operating systems that have now been decommissioned)

honors.title: TechOps Rockstar
honors.description:
Someone who fully encompasses the Tech Ops spirit with demonstrated excellence in most of these key areas.

Ever since Chris has joined our DevOps group he has gone beyond the call of duty. He consistently shows willingness to help, innovate and solve technical difficulties. Chris needs no prompting from project management, he has been a reliable and trusted resource on projects with complex execution.

honors.title: Team o'​ Ninjas: G2MWT DR
honors.description:
This team stuck through six weeks for muck sucking DRT
gap analysis, stage testing live readiness configuration,
new automation wrangling, countless meetings and DR
reschedule that resulted in one of the finest DRT
executions on record for the G2MWT cloud.
Revamping last year’s checklist, excel spreadsheet, and
manual process tedium, this year’s DRT was processed in
four straightforward scripted phases. Each one of these
scripts used remote callouts to our new Service Control
agent. Great job in execution, and great job in going the
extra mile with a new automation framework.

projects.title: XUI - External User Interface
projects.description: Connecting three networks to gather data from weather sensors via FTPS, store data in SQL 2008 DB via PowerShell Script with custom modification of data to perform calculus functions on the data to provide vector wind speeds and direction and averages and maxes over 5-10 minute intervals. Build web server and database server as well as SQL database and PowerShell scripts, and enabled PKI to authenticate to the web server in a DMZ. Consulted for technical meetings and provided detailed documentation on the design and development stages throughout the project. Built web application with ASP.NET and C#.
